title: Israel’s president accepts certified election results ahead of talks on forming of new government - NBC News
description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog on Wednesday accepted as legally binding the certified results from last week’s parliamentary elections and said he would begin consultations with party representatives on the formation of a new government.

title: Voters punish Trump with historic swing to Democrats - The Washington Post
description: Voters frustrated by high prices, corruption and yet another war in the Middle East sent Republicans a stark message by unseating incumbents and handing Democrats control of the House and Senate.

title: Voters deliver stunning rebuke of Trump as Democrats take control of House and Senate - CNN
description: Democrats still adding to historic midterm gains with more wins in the House and Senate. Follow for live updates.

title: Expecting a new grandchild? Here’s why you may need to see your doctor first - CNN
description: When a baby is on the way, doctors often recommend that the mother get certain vaccinations to protect her newborn – and it turns out that other family members who may visit the infant, especially grandparents, are urged to be up to date on certain shots, too.

title: Texas election results 2026: Live updates on U.S. Senate, governor and statewide races - KUT
description: James Talarico wins Texas' U.S. Senate race, while Gov. Greg Abbott concedes to Gina Hinojosa. Here's where other statewide races stand.
